lines.en: I walk on fallen leaves, rustling.

lines.zh: 身上长着叶子，走起来扇风
lines.en: Leaves grow on me and fan the air as I walk.

lines.zh: 我的根不在土里，在脚底
lines.en: My roots aren't in the soil; they're in my soles.

lines.zh: 橡树底下是我常走的路
lines.en: I keep to the paths under the oaks.
I shake and two leaves fall.
Walking sounds like wind through a canopy.

lines.zh: 脚一落地，草就长高一点
lines.en: Where I step, the grass grows a little.
The leaves on me are yellowing.
I move slowly, like a tree shifting.

lines.zh: 前面那棵橡树，我去看看
lines.en: That oak ahead; I'll go see it.

lines.zh: 走过的地方留下一片绿
lines.en: I leave a patch of green where I pass.

lines.zh: 我站着不动，像一丛灌木
lines.en: I stand still like a shrub.

lines.zh: 风一吹，我身上的叶子都响
lines.en: The wind sets every leaf on me rustling.

lines.zh: 我在等一片叶子落下来
lines.en: I'm waiting for a leaf to fall.
There are acorns below; I don't step on them.
The branches on my back are heavy.
I don't need food; I need light.

lines.zh: 树皮一样的皮，摸起来糙
lines.en: My bark-like hide is rough.
I lean toward the light.
There are bugs on my leaves.

lines.zh: 我慢慢地呼吸，像树一样
lines.en: I breathe slowly, like a tree.
This oak smells good.
There's wind coming from far off.
I spread my leaves open.
I grow an inch a season.
A leaf fell off; I don't mind.
I have leaves, no flowers.
I can feel the water in the soil.
Someone sat down under the tree.
You're standing on fallen leaves.
Is that wood in your hand?
Don't pluck the leaves on me.
You don't smell of trees.
I rustle my leaves for an answer.
You're blocking my sun.

lines.zh: 我站在这里，和灌木一样
lines.en: I stand here like a shrub.
What's funny? Am I amusing?
The wind's here; listen.

lines.zh: 我们之间隔着一片落叶
lines.en: There's a fallen leaf between us.
You lifted your foot.
Stand off, my roots are here.
A twig snapped.
I stepped back, roots still firm.
A patch of bark was cut away.
I don't cry out; trees don't.
That kept me swaying a long while.
I leaned aside and came back.
A little sap seeped out.
Hit again and I'll lose all my leaves.
A branch broke; my roots still hold.
Leaves; I only want leaves.

lines.zh: 你手里那把橡树叶，不错
lines.en: That handful of oak leaves is good.
I like logs too.
Were those picked from a tree?
Put them down; I'll look.
This is greener than mine.
Lay them on the ground.
I smell sap.
You can trade this for me.
I bumped it and leaves fell.
Touching me is like touching a tree.
I back off, roots still planted.
That snapped a twig.
My bark will scrape your hand.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，叶子乱飞
lines.en: We collided and leaves flew.
I swayed once and held.
A few more leaves on the ground.
You brushed past my branches.
Trees work differently.

lines.zh: 我是从十六片叶子里长出来的
lines.en: I grew from sixteen leaves.
Another clump is deeper in the wood.

lines.zh: 我们开花的时候才谈这个
lines.en: We talk about that when we flower.
I don't flower.
The wind carries for us.

lines.zh: 这片林子里，只有我这样
lines.en: I'm the only one like this in this wood.
Ask the trees.
My leaves are falling off.
Quiet, the light is just right.
I pick up a leaf.
Everything on the ground is useful to me.
I curl it up with a twig.
I like this piece of wood.
I don't bend; I crouch.
This could go under my feet.

lines.zh: 叶子塞在身上就粘住了
lines.en: Leaves stick to me when I press them on.
My roots have tangled round it.
Fallen leaves on the ground are mine.
Too heavy; I push it along.
A leaf over there is moving.
I see a sapling.
The wind's coming, good.
The light is good that way.
Let me see if it's a tree.
This oak is fine.
I lean toward that patch of light.
That thing blocks the light.
Over there.
I extend a branch.
Not far.
I lean that way.
My roots drag on the ground.
My leaves rustle.
It hid behind a tree.
I know that tree.
My branches won't reach that far.
I pause for the light.
It stopped.
It's stepping on the leaves.
A branch whips out.
I slam into it like a falling trunk.
Leaves flew into its face.
The branches caught it.
My roots push up from below.
After the hit I stand still.
The bark scraped off.
It retreated and leaves fell everywhere.
I sway back and straighten.

lines.zh: 商人用橡树叶把我换来
lines.en: The merchant traded oak leaves for me.
I rise out of a pile of leaves.

lines.zh: 身上刚长出第一片叶子
lines.en: The first leaf just grew on me.
There are oaks here, good.
I shake and soil falls off.
I look up for light.
I've memorized the grass under me.

lines.zh: 我是一季一季长出来的东西
lines.en: I'm something that grows season by season.
The ground here is decent.
I slowly unfold my branches.

lines.zh: 地上多了几片不是自己的叶
lines.en: A few leaves on the ground aren't mine.
I'm set, and the wind is right.
Fire curled my leaves first.
I fell and crushed the grass.
Water soaks my roots; I feel heavy.
The blast scattered my branches.
Something lodged in my bark.
The spell hit and my leaves shook on their own.
Without light, I slowly wither.

lines.zh: 雷打在树上，我整丛都亮了
lines.en: Lightning hit the tree and my whole clump lit up.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有土，我的根没地方去
lines.en: No soil in the void; nowhere for my roots.
